import numpy as np
# MECHANISM: Use a piecewise linear function with more granular thresholds to prioritize bins.

def priority(item, bins):
    thresholds = [50, 100, 125, 140]
    scores = np.zeros_like(bins)
    for i, threshold in enumerate(thresholds):
        mask = (bins >= threshold) & (bins < threshold + 5)
        scores[mask] = (thresholds[min(i + 1, len(thresholds) - 1)] - bins[mask]) / 5
    return scores
